customer.business: HomeWalk (hellohomewalk.com): turns a builder's 2D house plans into a browser-based 3D walkthrough and photoreal stills before the home is built
customer.target: Owners, sales or marketing leads at Utah custom and spec/semi-custom home builders who decide how an unbuilt home is shown to clients or buyers
customer.where: Utah: Utah County, Salt Lake, Heber/Park City, St. George

segments.name: Owner of a small custom builder (1-6 homes a year, client brings or hires an architect)
Owner of a mid-size custom/semi-custom builder (7-20 homes a year)
Sales, marketing or drafting lead at a spec/production builder with a library of 20-100+ plans

behaviours.name: Architect or in-house team already covers it
behaviours.how: Their architect, designer or an in-house hire already makes 3D models or renders, usually paid inside the architecture fee.

behaviours.name: Cost-plus pass-through
behaviours.how: Bills homeowners cost-plus; will add a line item only if the homeowner agrees to pay for it.

behaviours.name: Too busy right now
behaviours.how: Has more work than time; says 'email me something' and rarely gets back to it.

behaviours.name: Sells with photos of finished homes
behaviours.how: Uses Matterport or photos after the home is built; buyers have never asked to see it before construction.

behaviours.name: Lost their renderer / open to a vendor
behaviours.how: Previous rendering source went away or is leaving; actively looking for someone reliable.

behaviours.name: Bulk buyer for the website
behaviours.how: Wants per-plan pricing for many plans to put walkthroughs on the company website; the boss decides with no deadline.

pitch:
HomeWalk, a Utah company, turns your house plans (PDF, CAD, Revit or SketchUp) into a 3D walkthrough your client opens in a web browser on their phone or computer, plus photoreal still images, before construction starts, so they can see the layout, light and finishes while changes are still cheap.
Standard: $1,500 per home, an interactive walkthrough plus still images, delivered in about one business day once plans are complete. Revisions are $500 a round.
Premium: up to $4,000 per home, adds a video flythrough and more high-quality stills for marketing.
Branded with your company name. You can put it on the architecture or pre-construction line and pass it to the homeowner.
To start: we build one of your current plans first, no deposit, and show it to you over lunch. You pay only if you like it.
